decisions.rationale: SITE_PID 555682754 already exists in the 2026-06-09 baseline as feature_id 300616, Reserva Particular do Patrimonio Natural Fazenda Sao Jose, Gleba Itinga A - Lote 390. Upstream kept the key and changed the footprint, which now matches what a different reserve (feature 300615, Fazenda Santo Antonio do Pindare, Gleba Barra da Jurema) had in June. The key settles identity, so this record keeps feature_id 300616; reusing 300615 would merge two distinct reserves and assigning a new ID would abandon a live one. The identical footprint looks like an upstream geometry error worth reporting to Protected Planet.

SITE_PID 555732174 already owns feature_id 255953 for Tjärnberget (Natura 2000 SCI). Its November geometry now matches separate Habitats Directive designation 132873 / SITE_PID 555533827, and both source records remain present in November. Keeping 255953 preserves the two distinct designations and their established identities; reusing 132873 would merge existing records. The maintainer explicitly approved keeping 255953.
